decisions.strongest_defeater: MethaneState contains MonitoringMethaneFlow with Start_Monitoring trigger, suggesting monitoring behavior.
decisions.violated_obligation: MethaneState exhibits behavior 'pump is controlling or monitoring the methane flow'.

decisions.basis: dossier obligation 0002:r1:i7 with NL-CONTRACT-NL3-INIT-1, binding state:PumpControl:line:6 state:PumpState:line:7 transition:line:26, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires first entry into PumpControl to be PumpState. Closed FCSTM initial entry for PumpControl is to InitialState via transition:line:26, and inspection/verify facts report PumpState unreachable from top-level initial. Receipt verdict false for S2. Existence of PumpState as composite child with internal initial transition does not satisfy owner-local initial entry.
decisions.violated_obligation: PumpControl initial pseudostate targets PumpState as first entry.

decisions.basis: dossier obligation 0002:r1:i8 with NL-CONTRACT-NL3-ENDPOINT-1, binding state:PumpControl:line:6 state:PumpState:line:7, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires transition to PumpState from PumpControl. Complete closed transition inventory contains no PumpControl to PumpState edge and verify reachability refutes PumpState. Receipt verdict false for S2.
decisions.violated_obligation: An explicit PumpControl -> PumpState transition exists.

decisions.basis: dossier obligation 0002:r1:i9 with NL-CONTRACT-NL4-ENDPOINT-1, binding state:PumpControl:line:6 state:WaterState:line:13, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false.
decisions.reason: NL4 requires PumpControl to WaterState transition. Closed transition inventory has none and verify reachability refutes WaterState. Receipt verdict false for S2.
decisions.violated_obligation: An explicit PumpControl -> WaterState transition exists.

result.reason: All 24 obligations were assessed against the supplied NL contracts, exact ModelIR bindings, inspection-equivalent and verify facts, and FCSTM backend receipts. Transition-existence, initial-entry, reachability, UML initial-trigger invariant, cardinality and deadlock-frontier obligations are established as violated by exact finite inventories and false verdicts; the system-initial-entry obligation remains unresolved due to missing binding; state-action obligations are established as missing state actions with indirect trigger evidence not rebutting the exact state_action contract.

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL3-INIT-1; inspection_equivalent_facts.states reachable_from_initial false for PumpState; verify_facts initial-entry refuted for PumpState scope; exact_source_inventory transitions tr_0002 to InitialState.
issues.expected: An unconditional initial entry owned by PumpControl that enters PumpState as the first substate.
issues.observed: PumpControl has an initial entry to InitialState via transition:line:26; PumpState is only entered via conditional initial transition [*] -> RunningState with trigger Activate_Pump in scope PumpState.
issues.reason: The NL requires PumpControl to first enter PumpState. The closed model shows PumpControl initial entry to InitialState and no PumpControl-owned initial edge to PumpState, making the required owner-local initial entry absent.
issues.requirement_quote: The system first transitions to the PumpState substate, where the pump is activated or controlled.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PumpState exists as a direct child of PumpControl and has an internal initial transition to RunningState, so the substate is declared and internally initialised.
issues.title: PumpControl initial entry does not target PumpState

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL3-ENDPOINT-1; inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions; verify_facts reachability refuted for PumpState.
issues.expected: A transition with source PumpControl and target PumpState.
issues.observed: No closed-model transition connects PumpControl to PumpState; PumpState is entered only via its own internal initial transition with trigger Activate_Pump.
issues.reason: The NL states the system first transitions to PumpState. The complete transition inventory contains no PumpControl-to-PumpState edge, so the required endpoint pair is absent.
issues.requirement_quote: The system first transitions to the PumpState substate, where the pump is activated or controlled.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PumpState is a direct child of PumpControl in the source inventory, establishing containment.
issues.title: Missing PumpControl -> PumpState transition

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL4-ENDPOINT-1; exact_source_inventory.states parent PumpControl for WaterState; inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions show no PumpControl->WaterState edge.
issues.expected: A transition with source PumpControl and target WaterState.
issues.observed: No closed-model transition connects PumpControl to WaterState; WaterState is entered only via internal initial transition [*] -> MonitoringWaterFlow with trigger Start_Monitoring.
issues.reason: NL4 requires a PumpControl to WaterState transition. The closed-model transition inventory lacks that endpoint pair.
issues.requirement_quote: The system can also transition to the WaterState substate, indicating that the pump is controlling or monitoring the water flow.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: WaterState is declared as a direct child of PumpControl in the source inventory.
